description.value: Cafe Monet is a Korean-influenced bakery and cafe on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, serving espresso drinks, matcha latte, smoothies, and shaved ice alongside baked goods. The air-conditioned indoor space is wheelchair accessible, making it a downtown pit stop in a high-traffic shopping and tourism corridor. The cafe operates under the name 'CAFE MONET Bakery & Cafe' in its own branding.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address, phone, and email matching OSM. The menu shows coffee, smoothies, shaved ice, and bakery items; the OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is consistent with the plant-based menu items visible on the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, and outdoor_seating=no eliminates patio visibility for bikes. The website footer contains unfilled Wix template placeholders ('내 사이트', 'info@mysite.com'), suggesting the site is minimally maintained, though the contact block is accurate.
concerns: Website footer contains unfilled Wix template placeholders: site title shows '내 사이트' (Korean for 'My Site') and footer email shows 'info@mysite.com' instead of the business email — indicates the website is minimally configured and may not be actively maintained.
OSM outdoor_seating=no means no patio visibility for bike watching; no bike rack or parking tags present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags; on-site verification is needed before this cafe can be listed.
